description: Add or remove flags on multiple messages in one operation. Provide EITHER `uids` OR `match`, plus at least one of `flagsToAdd` / `flagsToRemove`. Same flag whitelist as update_message_flags.

dryRun.description: When true, preview the exact UIDs that would be updated without changing any flags. Run this first for match-based selections.

flagsToAdd.description: Flags to add across all selected messages. System flags include the backslash (e.g. ["\\Seen"]); user keywords are bare (e.g. ["Important"]). At least one of flagsToAdd/flagsToRemove must be non-empty.

flagsToRemove.description: Flags to remove across all selected messages (e.g. ["\\Seen"] to mark unread).

match.description: Search criteria selecting the messages to update (same fields as search_messages). Mutually exclusive with `uids`.

attachmentName.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on attachment filenames (e.g. "invoice", ".pdf"). Implies hasAttachment.

attachmentType.description: Case-insensitive MIME-type prefix filter on attachments (e.g. "application/pdf", "image/"). Implies hasAttachment.

uids.description: Explicit UIDs to update, scoped to `folder`. Mutually exclusive with `match` — provide exactly one.

name: bulk_update_flags
